verdict.rationale: Braintrust captures the underlying metrics (latency, token usage/cost, and eval scores via traces and experiments) and mentions that its Loop AI agent can 'build scorers, datasets, and dashboards' on request, but there is no first-party documentation of a dedicated dashboard-building UI/feature for combining latency, error, cost, and eval-score metrics into custom views. missing for 10: explicit dashboard-builder documentation/screenshots, evidence of combining error-rate metrics with cost/latency/eval-score in one dashboard, and independent confirmation the AI-agent-built dashboards are customizable and durable.
